transcript.text: I need to flag a critical IT issue before this plan is finalized. District learning-management-system authentication will be offline for scheduled maintenance from 8:00 to 11:00 a.m. tomorrow. I confirmed the maintenance window with the vendor today, but the vendor notice has not yet been attached to the remote-day draft. This means the draft plan's assumption that instruction can be delivered through the LMS beginning at 8:00 a.m. will not work. Instead, instructional files must be distributed by email as downloadable PDFs and made available for printing by 7:30 a.m. This also compounds Ms. Green's concern — the 38 households without reliable internet will need those printed packets ready even earlier since they cannot access email-delivered materials either.
